value.rationale: The genus (number of gaps) is an independently motivated, canonical invariant of numerical semigroups. The exact cubic-plus-arithmetic-correction law for the entire coprime m>Q range and the complete one-row Apéry transition resolve the adjacent subthreshold regime that published Frobenius work did not evaluate. The result gives a strict criterion for exceptions and an explicit stabilization threshold; it is not a sample computation or a renamed textbook identity.
